title: cerasus glandulosa f. rosea
intro: Cerasus glandulosa f. rosea, commonly known as Rose Hawthorn, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Prunus genus. It is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating anxiety and stress due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rose Hawthorn include promoting relaxation and acting as an antioxidant, thanks to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Additionally, its bioactive constituents, including salicylic acid and phenolic compounds, contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
